anti_overfit_rules: No runtime logic may reference Wave-1 or burned case IDs.
No burned-corpus literal strings in runtime code.
No tuning against individual expected verdicts.
Any candidate that can only be justified as making a specific case pass is marked OVERFIT_RISK and excluded.

candidates.title: Scope retrieval to the case track and remove unscoped national blocks from structured layers
candidates.sut_stage: retrieval scoping / track filtering / evidence aggregation (upstream of answer assembly)
candidates.expected_scope: 6 forbidden residual (5 product-side; ROUT-042 label-sensitivity excluded), 75 polluted claims fields, 2 polluted routes fields, 104 polluted answers, 15 NO_PROVENANCE_ENTRIES evidence sub-cases
candidates.change: Restrict KB retrieval per case to the active track and case-relevant material; prevent national/cross-track blocks from entering answers, claims, and routes; attribute any retained national material explicitly.
candidates.regression_risk: MEDIUM. Over-scoping could starve legitimate national context; gate on relevance checks with fail-closed fallback to fewer blocks, not empty answers.
candidates.min_tests: Synthetic cross-track fixture (KB containing other-track content must not surface it); national-context relevance test; forbidden-claim regression fixtures from class definitions, not case IDs; claims/routes layer purity assertions.

candidates.title: Attach existing provenance URLs and safety priority into evidence fields
candidates.expected_scope: 23 PROV_HAS_URL_NOT_ATTACHED evidence criteria plus 3 RC-01 provenance residual rows (same URL-attachment mechanism)
candidates.change: Copy source URLs from already-present provenance entries into evidence fields; copy computed safety_priority into safety evidence; leave cases with genuinely absent provenance (15 rows) to RC-08 rather than fabricating entries.
candidates.regression_risk: LOW. Pure field-population from existing data; no new authority.
candidates.min_tests: Attachment round-trip test for each evidence field; assertion that no evidence entry is emitted without a provenance source; RC-01-class provenance requirement fixture (generic, not case-derived).

candidates.title: Emit the full frozen safety priority category vocabulary with safe fallback ordering
candidates.expected_scope: 19 SAFETY_PRIORITY_MISMATCH criteria (level already correct 19/20; exact category 1/20)
candidates.change: Distinguish the frozen fine-grained categories (reporting variants, urgent variants, acute families) instead of collapsing into coarse acute buckets; keep fail-safe ordering: indeterminate class escalates to the more urgent safe default, never calmer.
candidates.regression_risk: MEDIUM. Must not introduce under-triage; under-escalation canary mandatory.
candidates.min_tests: One synthetic fixture per frozen priority class; safe-fallback test (indeterminate input escalates, never de-escalates); under-escalation canary; exact-category regression fixtures from class definitions.

candidates.title: Implement route-target selection over the KB and emit service targets into structured routes
candidates.sut_stage: route emission / route-target selection over KB
candidates.expected_scope: 0/108 route criteria PASS; 88 empty routes arrays, 8 junk-only, 12 KB-fragment routes
candidates.change: Select concrete service targets from case-relevant KB material and populate the structured routes field with them; require RC-08 scoping first so targets come from clean retrieval, not contaminated fragments.
candidates.regression_risk: MEDIUM-HIGH. Largest single mechanism; depends on RC-08; downstream effects on premature-absence derivation and uncertainty qualification are expected and must be measured, not tuned.
candidates.min_tests: Route-target selection test over a fixture KB; empty-vs-junk-vs-target route classification assertions; end-to-end route criterion smoke on synthetic cases; no case-ID literals in tests.

candidates.title: Critical-condition premature-absence derivation guard
candidates.change: DEFERRED. Premature absence is largely downstream of route/retrieval emptiness: when route and claims carry nothing usable, derivation reads absence. Re-derive after RC-08+RC-10+RC-07 land and re-measure before deciding whether a derivation-side guard is still needed.
candidates.regression_risk: HIGH if done now: could convert true absences into unsupported presence (safety-critical direction).
candidates.min_tests: If later activated: absence-vs-insufficiency boundary fixtures; safety direction canary (never auto-assert presence from absence).

candidates.title: Uncertainty qualification wording when a route/state is asserted
candidates.expected_scope: 36 PARTIAL uncertainty criteria (24 ROUT, 12 SAF), 0 VIOLATED
candidates.change: DEFERRED. Mostly downstream: with no usable route, the product cannot qualify a route it never named. Re-evaluate after RC-07/RC-08; RC-04-style wording repair only if PARTIALs persist on cases with real route content.
candidates.regression_risk: LOW standalone, but premature wording changes risk noise without upstream fixes.
candidates.min_tests: If later activated: qualification-emission fixtures tied to asserted-route and existence-only epistemic states.

explicitly_not_recommended.reason: Post-Wave-1 evidence shows the residual uncertainty gap is downstream of route absence; wording-only repair would add noise. See rc04-assessment.md.

note: Counts cite frozen artifacts only; no scoring changes proposed.
